title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Vermilion’ applies a one-note scarlet finish to the clog-like silhouette, marking the first time that Kanye West introduced the familiar monochrome palette to his partnership with the Three Stripes. The futuristic slip-on features a sustainable build, highlighted by a single piece of foam made in part with hydroponically produced algae. Ventilation ports throughout the vamp and side panels offer breathable comfort, while the sculpted heel is designed to cradle the back of the foot for a non-slip fit.
